Reasoning: This stage keeps the panda_fingertip pose fixed while executing a grasp. freeze_position and freeze_orientation encode no commanded translation or rotation of the end effector in the current robot-base pose. object_grasped encodes successful physical holding/stable grasp of the intended handle after finger closure, rather than merely reaching a closed gripper state. The available schema has no arguments on object_grasped or close_gripper, so the specific target top_drawer_handle_frame, symmetric finger closure along panda_fingertip +y, centered contact at the handle-frame origin, finger-effort stop criterion, fully-closed-without-contact failure, excessive finger effort failure, and explicit pose-loss failure cannot be represented directly; they are therefore omitted from Constraints beyond the fixed-pose and grasp-success requirements.

0.tolerance_m: MPC precision cap; compliant protrusion tool-hold rule

1.tolerance_rad: MPC angular default; ordinary angular-maintenance tolerance
